description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Diana''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] 15% – 35% (based on level) '''bonus''' attack speed. After casting an [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|ability]], this bonus is tripled to 45% – 105% (based on level) for 5 seconds.
description.text: Innate: Diana gains  15% – 35% (based on level) bonus attack speed. After casting an ability, this bonus is tripled to 45% – 105% (based on level) for 5 seconds.

description2.raw: '''Innate - Moonsilver Blade:''' '''Diana's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] generate a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Moonsilver Blade'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, '''Diana''' empowers her next basic attack to consume the stacks [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] to additionally cleave nearby enemies, dealing them 20 – 220 (based on level) (+ 50% AP) magic damage. ''Moonsilver Blade'' deals 270% damage against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description2.text: Innate - Moonsilver Blade: Diana's basic attacks on-hit generate a stack of Moonsilver Blade for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, Diana empowers her next basic attack to consume the stacks on-hit to additionally cleave nearby enemies, dealing them 20 – 220 (based on level) (+ 50% AP) magic damage. Moonsilver Blade deals 270% damage against monsters.

notes.raw: * ''Moonsilver Blade'' will affect [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. * Each attack has a distinct animation and she will glow when the empowered attack is ready. * When the stacks are consumed [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] (e.g [[File:Guinsoo's Rageblade item.png|20xpx|border|link=Guinsoo's Rageblade|An icon for the item Guinsoo's Rageblade]] [[Guinsoo's Rageblade]], [[File:Dusk and Dawn item.png|20xpx|border|link=Dusk and Dawn|An icon for the item Dusk and Dawn]] [[Dusk and Dawn]]), additional damage is only applied to the on-hit target, without triggering the cleave on nearby enemies. [https://www.reddit.com/r/DianaMains/comments/u7hlez/guinsoos_rageblade_interaction_with_dianas/] * Sometimes, the empowered basic attack will not consume the stacks.(bug) ** In this case, the attack will also not deal its damage.
notes.text:
Moonsilver Blade will affect structures.
Each attack has a distinct animation and she will glow when the empowered attack is ready.
When the stacks are consumed on-hit (e.g Guinsoo's Rageblade, Dusk and Dawn), additional damage is only applied to the on-hit target, without triggering the cleave on nearby enemies. [https://www.reddit.com/r/DianaMains/comments/u7hlez/guinsoos_rageblade_interaction_with_dianas/]
Sometimes, the empowered basic attack will not consume the stacks.(bug)
* In this case, the attack will also not deal its damage.
